paragraphs: RMGC Construction Inc is a North York–based construction company led by Roger, working across Toronto and the surrounding GTA. We take on residential renovations and commercial build-outs — and the responsibility that comes with them.

That means arriving when we say we will, protecting your floors and furniture before the first tool comes out, flagging problems we find behind the walls instead of covering them up, and leaving the space cleaner than we found it. Most of our work comes from referrals and repeat clients — the only endorsement in this trade that really counts.
We carry $5,000,000 in liability insurance and are WSIB insured — your property and everyone on your site is properly covered, on every job, without exception.
